PluginData.Tooltip: 0.3.0 diagnostic: finds a tagged cargo that actually contains Ice, requests one exact 1 kg transfer, then verifies +2s/+5s.
PluginData.Description:
One-shot client plugin for Keen multiplayer server-authority testing.
Setup: - Any number of cargo containers may have [IceSource] in the BLOCK NAME. - At least one tagged cargo must actually contain 1 kg or more of Ice. - Rename one or more O2/H2 Generators so the BLOCK NAME includes [IceTest]. - Custom Data is not used for either tag. - Keep the blocks on the grid you are actively controlling from a cockpit or control seat. - Keep the [IceTest] generator OFF during the diagnostic so it does not consume the test Ice. - The plugin disables Use Conveyor and Auto-Refill on the selected [IceTest] generator. - Version 0.3.0 checks every tagged cargo on the controlled grid and selects the first one that contains at least 1 kg of Ice and can transfer to the target. - It requests exactly 1 kg once, records immediate inventory values, then verifies both inventories after 2 seconds and 5 seconds. - The log reports SERVER ACCEPTED, SERVER NOT CONFIRMED, or AMBIGUOUS based on source/target deltas. - Diagnostics are written to %APPDATA%\SpaceEngineers\IcePulseTest.log.
This is a narrow inventory-transfer proof of concept, not a general Programmable Block script runner.
